services.desc: Thank you for your inquiry, Long Pond Lodge and the Adirondack-Champlain guide service has been a family business since 1978. Our lodge is located four miles off the NYS Northway (rt. 87), exit 33. We are approximately one hour and fifteen minutes north of Lake George, one half hour east of lake placid, and about twenty minutes south of Plattsburgh, NY. Our unique location puts us within easy driving distance of most people living in the northeast (usually less than six hours away). We are centrally located in a great fishing area. Hundreds of lakes, ponds, streams, and rivers of the Adirondack Mountains and Lake Champlain surround us. Many species of game fish are found in these waters
